symptom: Closing or refreshing pages permanently consumes server surface capacity until every RPC requires a service restart
direct_cause: Page UUID surfaces were held in a permanent Map without an SSE lease or expiry
class_root: Browser authorization surfaces must be leased and reclaimed separately from durable background jobs
internal_only_reason: The Nomi surface authority is a domain authorization object; jobs have separate persistent ownership
invariants: Disconnected surfaces expire and can be reclaimed without restarting background jobs
Expired reconnects reload and recommit project authorization

door_reduction.why_not: RPC/upload, domain authorization, SSE connection and browser reconnect are distinct transport boundaries for the same lease

generality_proof: A single surface lease pool preserves connected clients and expires disconnected clients; capacity can reclaim only unleased entries, and browser detects a replaced authority

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Lease existing domain surfaces independently from durable jobs

same_class_entry_points.evidence: RPC and upload resolve through one leased pool
SSE retains an authority and detects replacement during reconnect

recurrence.reason: Every new page UUID repeats the leak
same_class_scan: door-map getWebSurface --roots=web: RPC and upload in server.ts
door-map createWebSurface --roots=web: rpc creation; inspected EventSource reconnect path

prevention.invariant: Unleased surfaces are reclaimed without interrupting server jobs
prevention.failure_mode: Capacity rejects only when all remaining surfaces are live; replaced authority triggers browser reload
prevention.strategy: SSE lease with 30-second reconnect grace and bounded unleased eviction

legacy_paths.rationale: New web transport keeps the existing runtime contract; there is no alternate legacy collector

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The application owns source windows and generation completion policy

migration: Existing browser UUIDs are leased on reconnect; no durable project or job changes
residual_risks: Live deployment disconnect and reconnect need verification

invariant_owner_layer.why: The lease pool owns volatile browser authorities
